pvIntelligence.howItWorksSubtitle: Fully automated pipeline from on-site inverters to AI analysis

howItWorksSteps.title: Data Collection
howItWorksSteps.desc: Our proprietary RTU (LTE Cat.M1) transmits inverter data to the cloud every 5 minutes. Supports major brands including Hyosung, Huawei, and Hyundai via RS-485 Modbus.

howItWorksSteps.title: Cross-Comparison Analysis
howItWorksSteps.desc: Compares capacity-to-output ratios across all sites for the same time window. Sites falling below -20%p from the median are automatically flagged as anomaly candidates.

howItWorksSteps.title: AI Root Cause Analysis
howItWorksSteps.desc: When an anomaly is detected, AI synthesizes weather data, per-inverter output, and historical patterns to estimate the cause and provide natural language action guidance.

howItWorksSteps.title: Loss Calculation & Alerts
howItWorksSteps.desc: Automatically calculates daily/monthly estimated loss amounts and sends instant alerts via KakaoTalk (with SMS fallback).

pvIntelligence.aiDetectionSubtitle: Here's how PV REMS catches the problems that actually happen in the field.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: One out of seven plants just stopped producing
aiDetectionScenarios.what: The other six are running fine, but the Cheongna warehouse site has been at 13% efficiency since morning. It's not the weather.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: AI flags a likely grid interconnection issue and recommends checking the MCCB. Left alone, that's roughly ₩1.38M lost per month.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: One inverter keeps dropping output every afternoon
aiDetectionScenarios.what: Mornings are fine, but from 2 PM onward inverter #2 loses 30% output. The site next door is unaffected.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: Hourly cross-comparison pinpoints afternoon shading or string contamination as likely causes, and tells you exactly what to check on-site.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: Revenue is quietly shrinking and nobody noticed
aiDetectionScenarios.what: Day to day it looks normal, but over the past month average efficiency across all sites has slipped 3%p.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: Flags that panel cleaning is overdue, and shows that spending ₩150K on cleaning could recover about ₩530K/month in lost revenue.

peakEss.heroSubtitle: AI-based Peak Power Reduction ESS Optimal Control System
peakEss.heroDesc: AI learns building and factory power usage patterns to precisely predict peak times and optimally control ESS charge/discharge schedules. Significantly reduces demand charges and efficiently manages contracted power capacity.
peakEss.backgroundDesc: In industrial and commercial electricity tariffs, the basic charge (demand charge) is determined by the monthly maximum peak power. Since a brief peak moment determines the entire month's basic charge, peak management is the key to electricity cost reduction.

backgroundItems.title: High Demand Charge Ratio
backgroundItems.desc: Demand charges account for 30-40% of industrial electricity bills, determined by the 15-minute monthly peak.

backgroundItems.title: Inefficient Contracted Power
backgroundItems.desc: Many facilities maintain higher contracted power than needed to prepare for peaks, paying unnecessary basic charges.

backgroundItems.title: Limitations of Manual Control
backgroundItems.desc: Conventional ESS operates on fixed schedules, failing to respond to varying load patterns with limited peak reduction effect.

peakEss.solutionDesc: Ninewatt's Peak Shaving ESS Optimal Control System combines AI prediction models with a real-time optimization engine to automatically control ESS charge/discharge.

solutionFeatures.title: AI Load Prediction
solutionFeatures.desc: Deep learning-based 15-minute power demand forecasting. Enhances accuracy by reflecting weather, day of week, season and other variables.

solutionFeatures.title: Optimal Charge/Discharge Scheduling
solutionFeatures.desc: Optimizes ESS charge/discharge timing and output based on predicted load profiles to minimize peaks.

solutionFeatures.title: Real-time Adaptive Control
solutionFeatures.desc: Monitors real-time power data and corrects prediction-actual gaps, immediately responding to unexpected peaks.

howSteps.title: Data Collection
howSteps.desc: Collects 15-minute power usage, weather data, and operational schedules for AI model training.

howSteps.title: Peak Prediction
howSteps.desc: Predicts next 24-hour power demand in 15-minute intervals, calculating peak timing and magnitude.

howSteps.title: Optimal Schedule Generation
howSteps.desc: Automatically generates optimal charge/discharge schedules considering peak reduction targets, ESS capacity, and SoC.

howSteps.title: Real-time Control
howSteps.desc: Automatically controls ESS per generated schedule while dynamically adjusting for real-time load variations.

peakEss.policyDesc: According to the 10th Basic Plan for Electricity Supply and Demand, the required capacity for peak shaving ESS in the metropolitan area is projected to grow significantly to 2,100MW by 2036. However, there is currently no plan for demand-side ESS utilization in the metropolitan area.
peakEss.policySource: * Source: 10th Basic Plan for Electricity Supply and Demand
peakEss.marketDesc: The demand-side ESS market has slowed since the special tariff expiration in 2019, and the compliance rate for mandatory public institution ESS installation remains low.

marketStats.label: Nationwide public institution ESS mandate compliance (88 of 502 institutions)
Gyeonggi Province compliance rate (17 of 70 institutions)

marketIssues: New installations ceased after special discount expiration (2019) and safety measure tightening
Difficulty securing budgets and high initial investment costs
Fire safety concerns and safety management burden
Low utilization rates of installed ESS due to lack of operational expertise
peakEss.sharedEssLinkDesc: Peak shaving ESS optimal control technology is not only an independent solution, but also operates as a core function in Ninewatt's Shared ESS business. Shared ESS connects a single large-capacity ESS to the distribution grid, enabling multiple buildings to share peak reduction benefits through virtual net metering.

sharedEssLinkItems.title: Multi-building Peak Management
sharedEssLinkItems.desc: Shared ESS AI optimal control analyzes and simultaneously manages peak times across multiple subscribers.

sharedEssLinkItems.title: Virtual Net Metering Cost Savings
sharedEssLinkItems.desc: Without physically installing ESS, buildings receive electricity cost savings through Shared ESS charge/discharge.

sharedEssLinkItems.title: Grid Flexibility Supply
sharedEssLinkItems.desc: Provides peak reduction during normal operations and grid stabilization during emergencies, generating additional revenue.

peakEss.ctaDesc: Reduce demand charges and optimize power operations with AI-based ESS optimal control.
